title: Core drafting / site plans
signal: Site plans, permit drawings, construction drawings, and architectural drafting with AI or CAD automation.
query: ("site plan" OR "permit drawing" OR "construction drawing" OR "architectural drafting") (AI OR LLM OR automation OR CAD) -mechanical -Fusion -Onshape -SolidWorks -Blender -mesh -STL -render -renders -rendering -3d -midjourney -dalle -enscape -lumion -twinmotion -SEO -Webflow -"single site plan" -"premium site plan"

title: Landscape plans
signal: Landscape architecture, planting plans, grading plans, and design automation.
query: ("landscape design" OR "landscape architecture" OR "planting plan" OR "grading plan") (AI OR LLM OR automation OR CAD OR GIS OR mapping) -mechanical -Fusion -Onshape -SolidWorks -Blender -mesh -STL -render -renders -3d -visualization -photo

title: Arboriculture / trees
signal: Tree inventories, tree protection, preservation plans, and mapping workflows.
query: (arborist OR arboriculture OR "tree inventory" OR "tree protection" OR "tree protection plan" OR "tree preservation plan") (AI OR LLM OR automation OR CAD OR GIS OR mapping) -mechanical -Fusion -Onshape -SolidWorks -Blender -mesh -STL -render -3d

title: Urban forestry / inventory
signal: Urban forestry, street-tree inventory, canopy, climate-risk, and municipal mapping workflows.
query: ("urban forestry" OR "urban forest" OR "street tree" OR "tree canopy" OR "tree inventory data") (AI OR automation OR GIS OR mapping OR "remote sensing" OR "climate risk" OR LiDAR) -mechanical -Fusion -Onshape -SolidWorks -Blender -mesh -STL -render -3d -"AI art" -prompt

title: High-signal needles
signal: Small query for exact overlaps that are easy to miss.
query: ("tree inventory" "AI") OR ("site plan" "LLM") OR ("architectural drafting" automation) OR ("urban forest" "tree inventory data") -mechanical -Fusion -Onshape -SolidWorks -Blender -mesh -STL -3d -SEO -Webflow -crypto
